words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, teaching, making known, and sign-marking; local Form II selects pedagogical causation while sign and mark senses remain secondary coloring
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَّمَهُ}} ({{tr:ʿallamahu}}) opens the ayah as another compact divine predicate: the explicit subject is absent, but the 3ms perfect keeps the agent from al-Raḥmān in 55:1 active across the sequence. Its Form II shape makes the act causative and pedagogical, not bare notifying: knowledge is made to reside in the recipient. The attached object suffix carries the human from 55:3 into this ayah, while the second object names what is taught, so the created human becomes the taught bearer of {{ar:ٱلْبَيَانَ}} ({{tr:al-bayāna}}). The root's sign and landmark field remains secondary but meaningful: teaching equips the human to know by marks, a pressure reinforced by al-aʿlām later in the surah (55:24). The reprise of teaching from ʿallama al-Qurʾān in 55:2 to ʿallamahu al-bayān in 55:4 pairs revealed content with human expressive capacity. Corpus contrasts sharpen the selection: God teaches names in 2:31, teaches book and wisdom in 62:2, does not teach poetry in 36:69, owns knowledge in 67:26, and knowledge can still become disputed in 45:17. The terse sequence and audible doubling in {{ar:عَلَّمَهُ}} ({{tr:ʿallamahu}}) make the two-word clause feel like compressed transfer into articulation.

topics.headline: elided subject continues the divine act chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not an isolated comment on language but a completed divine action continuing the opening chain from 55:1.
topics.reason: The finite perfect verb, 3ms agreement, recoverable subject, and active morphology cohere with the local predicate chain; no evidence introduces a new subject.

topics.headline: one verb governs recipient and content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human recipient and the taught faculty are both direct objects, so the verse distinguishes who is taught from what is imparted.
topics.reason: The clitic object and explicit accusative object are syntactically forced by the local frame, matching the CRITICAL double-object claim.

topics.headline: created human returns as bound recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from the created human in 55:3 to the taught recipient in 55:4 without the noun being repeated.
topics.reason: The masculine singular object suffix is strongly licensed as resuming the immediately preceding human referent, and the fused form makes that dependency visible.

topics.headline: Form II selects taught capacity over notification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb presents bayān as an installed capacity, not a notice delivered to a passive hearer or a skill self-acquired by the human.
topics.reason: The Form II causative pattern and the two-object frame select teaching or making know; nearby alternatives such as notification, passive result, or reflexive learning do not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: knowledge root retains sign-mark coloring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that teaching is linked to knowability and signs, while the local verb still means teaching rather than branding, landmarking, or naming the world.
topics.reason: The root includes accepted sign and mark branches, and 55:24 supplies a same-surah landmark recurrence; local Form II grammar narrows those branches to secondary semantic coloring.

topics.headline: teaching reprises from revelation to capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same teaching root links 55:2 and 55:4, moving from taught revelation to the human capacity for clarification.
topics.reason: The local reprise is direct inside the surah, and the cooccurrence evidence supports a knowledge-clarity field without making it an independent lexical sense.

topics.headline: other teaching scenes sharpen the selected object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bayān is one selected divine teaching object among named alternatives: names in 2:31, book and wisdom in 62:2, and not poetry in 36:69.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete parallels and contrasts: 2:31, 36:69, 62:2, 67:26, and 45:17 are useful as comparison, not as controllers of the local parse.

topics.headline: brevity and gemination carry transfer pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the asyndetic move after 55:3 and the doubled sound in the verb make creation flow immediately into equipped articulation.
topics.reason: The adjacent verbal predicates and Form II gemination are local formal facts; the sound observation is modest and supports, rather than replaces, the grammar.

words.gloss_range: the faculty or act of making meaning clear, articulate, distinct, and shareable
words.root_gloss_range: separation, between-ness, appearing clear, making clear, expression, proof, and distinction; local definite maṣdar selects the comprehensive clarifying faculty
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَيَانَ}} ({{tr:al-bayāna}}) is the second direct object of {{ar:عَلَّمَهُ}} ({{tr:ʿallamahu}}), so it is what is taught, not the instrument by which teaching happens. Its definite singular maṣdar form names the recognizable faculty as a whole: not one utterance, one proof, or one episode of expression, but the capacity for clarification. The b-y-n field keeps speech, exposition, proof, and distinction together; clarity is not mere sound but the making of hidden or confused meaning manifest by separating it into legible signs. That wider range is locally narrowed by the grammar to a taught human faculty, while modern representation language remains only an analogy for externalizing hidden structure. The final placement gives the noun closure weight: after the fused verb-pronoun, the ayah lands on the faculty itself, with the ending of {{ar:ٱلْبَيَانَ}} ({{tr:al-bayāna}}) answering al-insān from 55:3. Its rarity as this gerund among common b-y-n forms makes the abstraction marked, and the root continues to resonate through clear language in 26:195, clear Qur'an in 36:69, sent proofs in 57:25, manifest error in 62:2, and between-ness inside the surah at 55:20 and 55:44.

topics.headline: bayān is taught content, not instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bayān completes the teaching frame as the thing imparted, not as a tool or adverbial manner.
topics.reason: The accusative noun is syntactically forced as the explicit object governed by the teaching verb, blocking an instrumental reading.

topics.headline: definite maṣdar names the whole faculty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the complete recognizable faculty of clarification rather than an indefinite sample of speech or a set of individual proofs.
topics.reason: The definite article, lack of tanwīn, singular noun shape, and maṣdar category all point to a complete abstract faculty in this local object role.

topics.headline: speech expands into proof and distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bayān is not only vocal expression; it also carries the work of making meaning distinct, evident, and demonstrable.
topics.reason: Accepted b-y-n branches include appearance, disclosing meaning, and proof-related clarity; the local teaching frame keeps those as the faculty's semantic range.

topics.headline: hidden structure made legible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the transferable mechanism of bayān: differentiated signs can make hidden structure legible, while modern system language remains analogical rather than a local technical sense.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row's modern communication-system framing has a valid core in externalized clarity, but local grammar and historical lexicon narrow it to the general mechanism of making meaning legible.

topics.headline: final noun receives closure weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two-word ayah lands on bayān as its final payload, audibly pairing the human in 55:3 with the faculty taught in 55:4.
topics.reason: The noun follows the fused verb-pronoun, completes the clause, links in connected recitation, and shares terminal sound with the preceding human noun.

topics.headline: rare gerund marks abstraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root is familiar but this exact gerund is scarce, making the abstract faculty more marked than common between, clear, or proof forms.
topics.reason: The contextual profile flags the gerund as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows compare it with dominant b-y-n categories without claiming those categories are locally active.

topics.headline: b-y-n field connects faculty, clarity, proof, and between-ness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bayān belongs to a wider b-y-n network: clear language in 26:195, clear Qur'an in 36:69, sent proofs in 57:25, and spatial between-ness in 55:20 and 55:44.
topics.reason: The cited rows provide concrete echoes and contrasts at 26:195, 36:69, 57:25, 62:2, 67:26, 55:20, and 55:44; they illuminate the field without overriding the local maṣdar object.

topics.headline: generic human receives defining faculty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the generic human of 55:3 is immediately specified by a generic clarifying faculty in 55:4.
topics.reason: The boundary rows converge with definiteness: the unmodified species noun in 55:3 is followed by the complete taught faculty in 55:4.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form II verb عَلَّمَهُ governs the definite noun ٱلْبَيَانَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative teaching installs a capacity by which intended meaning can be made manifest through speech, writing, gesture, or sign.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge becoming clear to a knower supplies both the pedagogic transfer and its epistemic result.
Disclosure through expression or sign identifies the taught capacity as multimodal communication.

changed_reading.after: He caused the human to acquire the broader capacity to disclose intended meaning by speech or sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both عَلَّمَ and بَيَان carry branches of clearing or becoming manifest.
baseline_models.mechanism: Teaching is not merely depositing information; it causes what was unavailable or obscure to become perceptible and recognizable to the learner.

activation_trace.role: The transition into clear knowing supplies the learner-side transformation.
Emergence into visibility supplies the object-side manifestation that learning produces.

changed_reading.before: Teaching transfers a ready-made item called البيان.
changed_reading.after: Teaching effects an unveiling: meanings and distinctions become available to a knower.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories join a distinguishing mark under ع ل م to separation, interval, and connection under ب ي ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bayan can operate as relational intelligence: it marks differences, preserves an interval, and makes the resulting relation intelligible without forcing separation and connection into a single choice.

activation_trace.role: A visible or guiding mark supplies the act of discriminating one thing from another.
Parting after contact supplies differentiation as an active operation.
The interval between parties supplies an organized relational space.
A tie joining parties prevents distinction from collapsing into isolation.

changed_reading.before: Bayan is verbal clarity as a static property.
changed_reading.after: Bayan is a learned operation that differentiates, spaces, and relates things so they can be understood together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence places human bayan inside a mercy-framed chain of teaching, gathered recitation, creation, and renewed teaching. Bayan therefore becomes a received capacity for taking up and relaying meaning, not an autonomous human invention.

activation_trace.role: Expressive or sign-based disclosure supplies the human relay function.
Mercy and tenderness frame the subsequent acts of teaching as beneficent enablement.
The repeated clarification-through-teaching links the taught Quran to the taught human capacity.
Gathering into a whole makes the taught discourse an ordered collection rather than isolated utterances.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation make that gathered discourse transmissible.
Creative bringing into existence places the recipient between the two teaching acts.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 proceeds as mercy, teaching the Quran, creating the human, then teaching him bayan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mercy, two teaching clauses, gathered recitation, and human creation occur in sequence. Reader arrow: the sequence makes bayan the human uptake and relay of prior communication. Live alternative: the Quran and bayan are parallel gifts rather than a causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Bayan is a self-standing human communicative faculty.
changed_reading.after: Bayan is a mercy-shaped, received faculty by which the created human can take up and transmit ordered meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic calculation and the commanded balance turn distinction into calibration. Bayan becomes the learned ability to assign measures, align unlike terms, recognize limits, and prevent excess or short measure across cognitive and ethical domains.

activation_trace.role: A guiding differentiating mark supplies the discriminations that calibration requires.
Separation supplies the boundaries whose violation or preservation can be measured.
Counting and calculation supply a cosmic model of exact intelligibility.
Balancing and aligning two things turns bare difference into proportion.
Exceeding a limit in rebellion supplies the failure mode of uncalibrated distinction.
Justice and equity supply the normative direction of correct calibration.
Shortchanging measure supplies the concrete loss produced when calibration is corrupted.

structural_cues: 55:5 moves directly from human bayan to sun and moon by calculation.
55:7-9 repeats the balance and moves from cosmic placement to commands against excess and deficient measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: calculation, repeated balance, limit-crossing, equity, and short measure form one sequence. Reader arrow: the same discriminative faculty named in bayan enables measured judgment. Live alternative: the sequence analogizes cosmic and moral order without defining bayan.

changed_reading.after: Bayan also calibrates distinctions, proportions claims, and makes just limits cognitively actionable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bowed posture of nonhuman subjects is an intelligible act without speech. Placed beside human bayan, it opens a semiotic reading in which humans are taught both to make meaning by signs and to recognize meaningful order enacted bodily by creation.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by either expression or sign keeps bayan from being restricted to vocal speech.
Lowering the head and bending supplies a bodily, nonverbal act that can signify submission.

structural_cues: 55:6 gives the dual prostrating verb to the star or stemless plant and the tree immediately after the human-cosmic transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: nonhuman subjects enact bowing just after the bayan and calculation clauses. Reader arrow: bodily obedience functions as readable signification within the same ordered field. Live alternative: the bowing denotes obedience alone and does not expand bayan.

changed_reading.after: Human bayan is a multimodal sign-capacity situated within a creation whose ordered postures are themselves readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring question converts communicative capacity into answerability. A being taught bayan can recognize favors, formulate a response, and also perform denial; the gift therefore carries an ethical exposure absent from a merely ornamental eloquence.

activation_trace.role: Meaning disclosed in expression supplies the capacity presupposed by direct address and response.
Favors and benefits supply the repeatedly named object that the addressees must acknowledge or reject.
Contradicting truth supplies the communicative misuse tested by the refrain.

structural_cues: The same dual-address question recurs thirty-one times, repeatedly requiring the hearers to take a position.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: favors and truth-denial are repeatedly placed in an interrogative addressed to two parties. Reader arrow: teaching bayan makes those parties capable of answer and therefore answerable. Live alternative: the refrain is liturgical recognition rather than a forensic demand.

changed_reading.before: Bayan is the ability to communicate successfully.
changed_reading.after: Bayan is also the condition of dialogic responsibility: the taught speaker can acknowledge truth or expose denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two seas turn bayan's separation, interval, and tie into a productive boundary. Distinct bodies meet without destructive overrun, and hidden valuables emerge; differentiation is therefore an enabling relation rather than mere partition.

activation_trace.role: Parting and separation supply the preservation of distinct identities.
A tie joining parties supplies relation across the preserved difference.
Mixing and turbulence supply pressure toward undifferentiated contact.
Two opposing things arriving together supplies genuine encounter rather than isolation.
The interval in the repeated root supplies the bounded middle where meeting is regulated.
Aggressive crossing of a limit supplies the prohibited collapse of the boundary.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the value-producing result of regulated encounter.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 moves from releasing two seas to meeting, a barrier between them, non-overrun, and the emergence of pearl and coral.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mixture, meeting, an intervening barrier, non-overrun, and emergence occur in sequence. Reader arrow: the boundary enables encounter and yield instead of merely blocking contact. Live alternative: the yield is adjacent bounty, not an effect of bounded relation.

changed_reading.before: Bayan separates one thing from another.
changed_reading.after: Bayan establishes a permeable but non-transgressed relation in which difference can meet and become productive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to pass beyond cosmic regions activates bayan as a possible warrant-bearing discourse. Distances and sides are crossable only through effective authority or compelling proof, while a secondary tongue branch keeps verbal force live beside political or physical power.

activation_trace.role: Distance and a wide gap supply the separated domain that calls for authorized traversal.
Clean passage to the far side supplies the repeatedly challenged operation.
Regions and sides supply the bounded cosmic edges to be crossed.
Compelling proof supplies an evidentiary warrant for passage.
A forceful sharp tongue keeps a specifically verbal mode of efficacy available.

structural_cues: 55:33 addresses humans and jinn, repeats the verb of passing through, and makes sultan the sole stated condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: passage across cosmic sides requires sultan, whose branches include proof, authority, and a forceful tongue. Reader arrow: taught bayan may furnish warrant-bearing articulation that makes a limit-crossing valid. Live alternative: sultan is sheer divine permission or power with no relation to bayan.

changed_reading.before: Bayan clarifies what lies on either side of a boundary.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, bayan can also formulate the proof or authorization by which a boundary may legitimately be crossed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A temporal reversal moves from universal asking to a day when verbal interrogation is unnecessary because persons are recognized by marks. Bayan thus includes involuntary, embodied legibility: the person can disclose a state even when no answer is solicited.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides recognition supplies the focus-side bridge to visible evidence.
Disclosure by sign allows meaning to be evident without spoken testimony.
Asking and requesting supply the ordinary dialogic mode of dependent creatures.
The same act of asking, now negated, removes verbal elicitation at judgment.
Recognition and discrimination by an effect or sign supply the replacement for questioning.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known supplies embodied evidence.

structural_cues: 55:29 says all in the heavens and earth ask Him; 55:39 negates questioning about sin; 55:41 replaces it with recognition by marks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: asking is first universal, later unnecessary, and recognition proceeds by visible marks. Reader arrow: marks function as a terminal nonverbal mode of bayan. Live alternative: the marks are judicial evidence unrelated to the communicative gift in 55:4.

changed_reading.after: Bayan extends to the body's involuntary readability, where a state becomes evident before any answer is spoken.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing Name activates a referential layer of bayan. Naming raises a referent into salience and points toward it, so the taught gift includes not only forming statements but establishing shared reference.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing sign that directs attention supplies the referential function of a name.
Disclosure through word or sign supplies the shared act of pointing out what is meant.
A name as elevation and indication supplies the closing model of reference-making.

structural_cues: The surah closes by foregrounding the divine Name after a discourse repeatedly addressed through the Lord relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the final ayah foregrounds the Name, whose branch combines elevation and indication. Reader arrow: naming is one concrete operation of taught bayan because it makes a referent jointly salient. Live alternative: the closing Name glorifies independently of the human faculty.

changed_reading.before: Bayan combines already available words into clear claims.
changed_reading.after: Bayan also creates shared reference by naming, distinguishing, and directing attention toward what is meant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a rare upper-lip branch of ع ل م to the later resonant-clay description rather than using the ordinary teaching sense. It remains anchored in the focus's oral disclosure branch and in branch-backed bodily material. Render only as an embodied acoustic analogy, never as a replacement lexical translation of عَلَّمَهُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A rare focus branch places a visible cleft at the upper lip beside a bayan branch that includes spoken disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The marked cleft at the upper lip supplies a bodily aperture associated with articulation.
Disclosure by speech supplies the vocal event produced through the formed body.
Bringing the human material form into existence supplies the embodiment step.
Reverberating sound in dry matter supplies the acoustic potential of the created material.
Pottery supplies the formed resonant comparison for the human body.

changed_reading.before: Bayan is an abstract competence added to an already complete human body.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, bayan sounds through a formed, marked, resonant body; articulation is embodied rather than disembodied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the water branch under ع ل م is form-distant from ordinary teaching. It remains structurally anchored by the focus inventory and is reactivated by the two seas, mixing, interval, and non-overrun. Downstream prose must label it a hydraulic analogy for gathered knowledge and regulated disclosure, not a lexical sense of عَلَّمَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare gathered-water branch of ع ل م coexists with interval and wide-gap branches of ب ي ن in the focus inventories.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies the reservoir side of the material analogy for knowledge.
An interval between bodies supplies the channel or spacing that keeps gathered contents intelligible.
Abundant wide water reactivates the otherwise remote focus water branch.
Mixing and disorder supply uncontrolled flow as the analogy's risk.
Aggressive overstepping supplies the overflow that a regulating interval prevents.

changed_reading.after: As a contained hydraulic analogy, knowledge gathers like water while bayan channels and spaces its flow so meanings meet without overrunning one another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a specialized intermediate-state branch, including graded phonetic realization, against the dominant clarity reading. It remains directly rooted in the focus inventory and gains support from joined pairs in context. Render as a live model of mediation and graded articulation, not as a claim that البيان literally means one phonetic technique.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ب ي ن inventory includes an intermediate state between two poles alongside separation and connection.

activation_trace.role: An intermediate state between two ends, including graded articulation, supplies a nonbinary mode of bayan.
A tie between parties supplies continuity across the intermediate state.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies contextual pressure to understand duality relationally rather than as disconnection.

changed_reading.before: Bayan forces clean binary separation between alternatives.
changed_reading.after: Bayan may also teach controlled gradation: articulating a meaningful middle while keeping both endpoints and their relation perceptible.

strongest_changes: Bayan expanded from eloquent speech into a learned operation of disclosure by speech, sign, and embodied evidence.
Calculation and balance strengthened a reading of bayan as calibrated, justice-directed discrimination.
The two seas changed separation into a productive boundary that permits relation without overrun.
The refrain and the later recognition by marks made bayan both the basis of answerability and a mode of disclosure that can outlast speech.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots sustained opposed but coexisting mechanisms: unveiling and marking, separation and connection, verbal response and silent bodily legibility. Rare material branches also activated embodied, hydraulic, and graded-middle models that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening sequence strongly aligns Quranic teaching and human bayan but does not prove that the latter is causally derived from the former.
Balance, cosmic posture, and the sea boundary may be contextual analogies rather than extensions of the noun's lexical force.
The sultan reading remains split between proof, authority, verbal force, and sheer permission.
The lip-clay and water models depend on rare form-distant branches and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Articulation as making distinctions appear.** `ع ل م/B001` supplies learned disclosure and `ب ي ن/B004` supplies appearance and clarity. The later barrier “between” two seas (55:20, `ب ي ن/B002`) activates the spatial substrate of distinction. I infer that expression works by establishing perceptible boundaries. The ayah reads as teaching how to separate and relate meanings, not merely how to speak.
2. **Expression as connective mediation.** `ب ي ن/B003` (a tie between parties) remains distinct from the separation reading. The dual addressees of the refrain and the repeated paired structures supply a social cue; I infer that clear expression can join parties precisely by preserving their distinctions. The ayah also reads as instruction in relation-making.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:20 makes the surprise explicit: a “between” can prevent transgression while allowing encounter. This corrects any assumption that clarity dissolves difference; the packet instead makes disciplined separation a condition of relation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`ب ي ن` `B005` — “disclosing meaning,” with `ع ل م` `B001` — “teaching.”** Structural cue: the pronominal object links this teaching back to the created human, while the following ayat move from celestial calculation to paired submission and balance. Assigned role: disclosure equips the human to render distinctions explicit within an already ordered world. Packet evidence is the pronoun chain and the nearby sequence `بِحُسْبَانٍ` / `يَسْجُدَانِ` / `ٱلْمِيزَانَ`; inference: articulation is the human interface to perceived order. Reading change: `ٱلْبَيَانَ` becomes functional participation in distinction-making, not speech as an isolated faculty.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:9 reclassified disclosure as accountable capacity: once agents are commanded to maintain exact, straight measure, articulation can serve truthful distinction or enable its distortion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A merciful source imparts knowledge; recitation gathers speech, expression discloses meaning, and sensory recognition receives it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: merciful care `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; imparted knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; reading and recitation `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; gathered utterance and study `quranic:root_001211:B001/m01`; appearing and becoming clear `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; disclosure by speech or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; perception by sight, hearing, or sensation `quranic:root_000059:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Instruction is not only the transfer of propositions. Recitation first gathers articulated material; teaching makes it known; and *bayān* opens the gathered material into an evident meaning that can be seen, heard, or inwardly detected. Mercy supplies the social and affective frame for this movement from held knowledge to intelligible expression.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
